correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier-interval Parseval yields the multiplier q P_n for q >= n. Fourier inversion and a finite partial-fraction identity yield sign-definite positive mixtures of m^{-2s}; strict monotonicity of the corresponding cosine series gives the global optimal bounds. Two separated Laplace-method saddle points determine the stated limit constant. Independent exact rational checker passed 1211 finite assertions; boundary q=n valid almost everywhere. See RESULT.md Proof Steps 1-4.
